name: my-react
description: React and TypeScript knowledge for coding agents: five skills of rules and no process. design (state ownership, cutting components and hooks, services and boundaries, what a unit's interface must state), implement (using, building and optimizing hooks and components; store and service bodies), test (unit tests through a seam, journey tests over the mounted app, test honesty), review (a React checklist, silent failures, waterfalls, a performance diagnostic) and figma (a screen broken into existing, partial and new components). Use the skills alone, or with my-workflow, whose steps and agents pick them up by stack.
